parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of evaluating powers of TensorProduct expressions by modifying the `tensor_product_simp` function. The change is minimal and focused on the intended functionality.

issues.description: The patch does not handle cases where the base of the power is a more complex expression involving multiple TensorProducts or other quantum objects. This may lead to incomplete resolution of the issue.
The patch introduces a new line that is not aligned with the existing code style, which may affect maintainability.
